title: Recent advances in metal–organic and covalent organic frameworks for solar energy conversion and their photovoltaic efficiency
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00488H, Review Article
Umme Farwa, Faisal Haroon, Zeshan Ali Sandhu, Muhammad Danish, Mir Waqas Alam, Safyan Mukhtar, Mohd Farhan, Muhammad Asam Raza
The increasing requirement for sustainable energy solutions has demanded research on novel materials for solar energy conversion. MOFs and COFs are most suitable materials for such applications due to their structural and functional properties.
